paper_style.palette_strategy: 主文与附录结果图使用蓝/橙/红/绿的少量 categorical 或 sequential/diverging 映射；空间场图为每个物理量重复 field/error colorbar，定性图用透明度、线型或直接标签补充颜色。色彩多数承担方法、时间、状态或误差角色，但跨图没有单一的全局方法色表，且部分 pastel/heatmap 语义在灰度下会减弱。
paper_style.vector_raster_mix: PDF 正文文字、公式、表格规则和部分示意箭头为可提取矢量对象；Figure 1–6、10–22 的数据图和图像网格主要由嵌入 PNG/JPEG 或索引图像承载，caption 与表格文字仍为 PDF text/path。全部 50 个物理页已以 180 dpi PNG 渲染；含对象的页面逐页视觉检查。
paper_style.style_consistency: 正文与表格保持 ICLR LaTeX 的 Nimbus Roman/Computer Modern 体系，嵌入数据图常用 Arial/DejaVuSans 粗体标题与小字号轴标。表格规则在 Table 1–9/12 以 booktabs/minimal 为主，Table 10–11 使用 full grid；结果图反复使用直接 method headers、误差行或 spread band。视觉叙事稳定，但方法色、色条范围和 caption 结论句在不同对象之间未完全统一。

figures.label: Figure 7

caption.text: Figure 7: A Venn diagram illustrating entropy, conditional entropy, and mutual information between the true state x and latent variable z. H(x) and H(z) denote the Shannon entropy (total information) of x and z, respectively. Their symmetric overlap, I(z; x), represents the mutual information that quantifies how much information about the true dynamics is preserved in the Koopman representation. The non-overlapping regions, H(x|z) and H(z|x), correspond to the residual uncertainty not captured by I(z; x).

color.semantic_mapping: Green and pink circles encode H(z) and H(x); their pale overlap encodes shared mutual information.

figures.data_and_statistics: Explanatory diagram only; circle area has no quantitative scale and no uncertainty.
figures.evidence_relation: Appendix E defines entropy/MI/conditional MI and calls Figure 7; those definitions support the MI terms in Figure 1 and Eq. (8), rather than adding a new experiment.
design_strengths: The overlap directly visualizes the algebraic relation among the information quantities.
Labels are placed inside the relevant regions.
The soft fill colors distinguish total and shared information without a separate legend.
design_weaknesses: Set areas could be misread quantitatively.
Pastel green/pink are not robust in grayscale.

figures.reusable_pattern: Use an explicitly labeled overlap diagram to introduce information decompositions before presenting their estimators or bounds.

figures.label: Figure 8

caption.text: Figure 8: The autoregressive structure of Koopman representation. Top row (solid arrows): the original states xₜ₋ₙ evolve under the nonlinear map T. Bottom row (dashed arrows): the states are first encoded into latent variables zₜ₋ₙ, which then evolve linearly under the Koopman operator K. The latent variables are subsequently decoded back to approximate the original states. Thus, the latent evolution under Koopman representation captures essential structure but do not directly contain the full state information. Note: the dashed arrows represent the approximated Koopman representation in latent space, whereas the solid arrows denote the true underlying dynamics.

color.semantic_mapping: True and approximate flows are distinguished by solid versus dashed strokes and by T versus K labels.

encodings.y: original-state row above latent-state row

It does not quantify the information loss along any link.
The caption grammar contains a subject-number mismatch in “do not directly contain.”
figures.reusable_pattern: Use synchronized true/latent timelines with line-style redundancy to make an approximation boundary inspectable.

figures.label: Figure 9

caption.text: Figure 9: Spectral behavior of the Koopman operator under different regimes. Left: Eigenvalues of K (orange dots) lie on the complex unit circle (|λ| = 1), and those of Kⁿ with n = 7 (blue crosses) remain on the unit circle, indicating temporal coherence and preservation of information. Right: Eigenvalues of K lie strictly inside the complex unit circle (|λ| < 1), and the spectrum of Kⁿ contracts toward the origin as n increases, reflecting fast mixing and information dissipation.

figures.reusable_pattern: Use matched spectral-plane panels for stable and contracting regimes, keeping the reference boundary and power-operator marks identical.

figures.label: Figure 20

caption.text: Figure 20: Comparison between γ = 0.0 and γ = 0.5 on the physical simulation task with latent dimension 32. (a) Evolution of the eigenvalue spectrum over training epochs. (b) Heatmap of the latent covariance matrix for γ = 0.0 across epochs. (c) Heatmap of the latent covariance matrix for γ = 0.5 across epochs. With the addition of the von Neumann entropy regularizer, two clear effects emerge during training. First, the latent covariance matrix no longer collapses to a few dominant modes: the eigenvalue distribution becomes more uniform and remains close to full rank throughout optimization (see (a)), indicating that the model learns a richer set of modes rather than compressing them into a low-dimensional subspace. Second, the covariance structure transitions from highly sparse (when γ = 0) to dense and full-rank under entropy regularization (from (b) to (c)), verifying our theoretical prediction in Proposition 5.

color.semantic_mapping: Dark blue bars/heatmap cells indicate stronger eigenvalue or covariance mass; pale blue and legend entries distinguish γ conditions.

cross_object_system.visual_narrative: Figure 1 将 IB、Koopman operator、MI/VNE 与 spectral allocation 接到一个方法接口；Table 1 把 standard latent 与 Koopman representation 对齐；Table 2 与 Figures 2–6 依次承担主比较、谱/流形机制、长时域空间场、图动力学和系数消融；Figures 7–22 与 Tables 3–12 将定义、证明、输入、逐通道结果、成本、控制、架构和训练诊断展开为复现层。
cross_object_system.caption_system: Figure/Table caption 统一采用“标签 + 标题句 + setup/encoding/comparison”顺序。Figure 4、9、13–21 的 caption 进一步给出机制结论或稳定性解释；Table 2、6、7 定义缩写、highlight 和 spread。Caption 通常可脱离正文识别对象，但部分地图 caption 的结论句语法不完整，控制表的括号统计量仍待定义。
cross_object_system.table_header_system: 主结果表以 Task/Metric 或 Channel/Metric stub 配合模型列，按任务/通道分块并使用横线；Table 10–11 将 Components/Layer/Layer number/tensor shape/Activation 作为架构查找接口。绿色 best、蓝色 second-best 在 Table 2、6、8、9 重复出现；概念和配置表则使用多级或符号表头。
cross_object_system.method_result_ablation_link: Figure 1 与 Table 1 给出方法/目标接口，Propositions 1–5 的信息流与谱解释在 Table 2、Figures 2–5 中形成结果链；Figure 6 用 α/β/γ 删除与调节测试组件作用，Figure 20–21 将 γ 的几何效果扩展到谱、协方差与损失训练过程，Table 7 提供额外计算成本。
cross_object_system.main_appendix_link: 正文 Table 2、Figures 2–5 和 Figure 6 多次指向 Appendix G.5；附录 Figures 13–19、Table 6 将空间与通道结果展开，Tables 8–9 补充控制，Table 7 补充成本，Figures 20–22 与 Tables 10–12 补充诊断、图状态和架构/超参数。Appendix E/F 承担 Figure 7–9 所需的定义与证明。
cross_object_system.typography_consistency: 表格字体和正文 caption 的 serif/math 体系稳定；嵌入图形标题、轴标、map tick 和 qualitative labels 以 Arial/DejaVuSans 为主，字号从约 5–17 pt 波动。主文与附录的对象内层级清楚，但高密度 map/epoch grids 的小字显著提高查读成本。
cross_object_system.color_consistency: 蓝色经常表示模型/预测或 allocated information，橙/红色经常表示另一方法、真值/角度或 entropy trace，绿色常表示 best/ground truth；误差图使用独立 sequential/diverging colorbars。由于方法颜色和物理量 colorbar 没有完全全局固定，跨对象比较应以直接标签和 caption 为准。

most_reusable_patterns: 用 Figure 1 式 architecture → mechanism → allocation 三联图把理论术语绑定到实现接口。
用 Table 2/6 式分块主表在同一决策面放置 horizon、任务/通道、方法、spread 与 best/second-best 语义。
用 Figure 4/14–19 式同步 prediction/error montage 把长时域空间失败模式与标量指标分开承载。
用 Figure 6/20/21 式固定颜色、参数标题和 epoch checkpoints，将删除式消融、谱/协方差机制和训练诊断连成一条证据链。
highest_value_objects: Figure 1：方法接口与信息机制的最短视觉路径。
Table 2：跨物理任务的主比较与方法 headline。
Figure 2 + Figure 3：谱结构与表示流形的机制性定性证据。
Figure 6 + Figure 20：从最终流形到训练谱/协方差的消融闭环。
failure_patterns: 地图和 epoch grids 信息密度高，面板内字体、ticks 和 colorbar 在页面尺度偏小。
部分 caption 直接宣称稳定/更优，但没有在图内给出聚合误差、重复次数或统一的统计定义。
best/second-best 颜色依赖明显，灰度阅读与近 tie 识别较弱；全篇没有固定的全局方法色表。
控制表括号波动值、Figure 5 spread band 与 Table 7 timing repeats 的定义/分母未完全随对象给出。
final_judgment.one_sentence_visual_strategy: 论文以信息论方法图开场，以分块数值表和谱/流形/空间场结果承载主张，再用附录的定义、通道切片、控制、成本、架构和训练诊断把同一信息保留—防塌缩机制扩展到复现层。
